review_candidates.title: IT总监/经理/主管
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 核心职责 1. 项目集群交付管理 (Project Cluster Delivery Management) 负责领导和管理多条产品线下的复杂项目集群（Program）或大型项目组合（Portfolio）的全程交付工作，确保所有项目整体战略目标一致。 制定并维护项目集群的整体交付路线图、治理框架和里程碑计划，监控关键路径，对交付范围、进度、成本和质量进行综合管控。 建立并优化项目交付管理体系、流程和标准，推动项目管理标准化和数字化，提升整体交付效率与能效。 主导管理重大交付风险、问题和变更，具备出色的危机处理能力，确保项目平稳推进。 作为关键交付接口人，向高层管理层和关键客户汇报项目集群的整体健康状态和绩效。 2. 商务与售前支持 (Business & Pre-sales Support) 深度参与重大项目的售前阶段，负责解决方案的技术与交付可行性评估，识别潜在交付风险并提出专业建议。 主导或协助制定项目交付方案、实施路线图、资源计划和交付预算，为标书和合同中的交付承诺部分提供核心输入。 在合同谈判阶段，就交付范围、交付模式、验收标准、服务级别协议（SLA）等关键条款提供专业意见，保障合同的可执行性与公司利益。 与销售团队紧密协作，共同面向客户进行技术交流和方案宣讲，展现公司的专业交付能力，助力项目赢单。 3. 组织与团队建设 (Organization & Team Building) 负责交付团队的组织规划与发展，包括项目经理、技术专家等角色的招聘、培养、绩效管理和梯队建设。 打造高绩效、高凝聚力的交付团队，营造持续学习和改进的团队文化，提升团队的整体作战能力。 建立并推行人才能力模型和职业发展路径，为团队成员提供专业的教练和辅导，激发团队潜能。 协调与跨职能团队（产品、研发、测试、运维等）的资源与协作，确保组织高效协同。 4. 收入与收款管理 (Revenue & Collection Management) 对负责的产品线/项目集群的交付收入、毛利率和回款指标负责，确保财务目标的达成。 严格管理项目预算和成本，通过精益交付和高效运营，提升项目盈利水平。 主导项目里程碑验收和回款流程，确保项目按时验收、开票和回款，有效管理应收账款，加速现金流周转。 与财务部门、销售部门协同，分析和预测项目财务健康状况，及时采取纠偏措施。 任职要求 1、本科及以上学历，计算机科学、信息技术、工程管理或相关专业。 2、10年以上IT项目交付管理经验，至少5年以上管理大型项目集群（Program/Portfolio）或多条产品线交付的经验，有PMP、PgMP、PMI-ACP认证者优先。 3、具有从0到1组建或规模化发展交付团队的成功经验。 4、具备丰富的售前支持与合同谈判经验，熟悉IT项目招投标流程。 5、拥有直接负责项目P&L（收入、成本、利润）和回款管理的实战经验。 核心能力： 1、优秀战略与领导力： 能够制定清晰的交付战略，并激励团队朝着共同目标前进。 2、出色的客户关系管理能力： 善于与客户高层建立互信关系，有效管理客户期望。 3、强大的商业与财务敏锐度： 精通项目财务管理和风险控制，具备强烈的成本意识和经营思维。 4、复杂的问题解决与决策能力： 能在高压和模糊的环境下，快速分析问题并做出有效决策。 5、优秀的沟通与影响力： 能够与内外部各层级人员进行有效沟通和协调，推动共识达成。 6、深刻理解云计算、大数据、人工智能、企业级软件（SaaS/PaaS）等至少一个领域的技术和交付模式。

review_candidates.description: JOB SUMMARY Reporting to the Vice President – Information Technology, APAC, the Director – Business Applications & Solutions leads the Business Applications & Solutions capability across the region, owning strategy, governance, delivery and continuous evolution of the Company's business applications — including its internally developed Warehouse Management System — so that technology enables efficient, scalable and reliable operations while supporting customer requirements and business growth. The role requires a business leader who has evolved from the applications and software development domain, with enough technical depth to challenge architecture, engineering and vendor decisions without being drawn into hands-on delivery. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategy & Business Leadership Develop and execute the APAC Business Applications & Solutions strategy in alignment with the Company's business objectives and regional IT strategy. Establish trusted partnerships with business and operational leaders, advising senior leadership on technology opportunities, risks and investment priorities. Develop, forecast, manage and monitor the Business Applications & Solutions budget, exercising delegated financial authority within approved limits. epresent Business Applications & Solutions in regional leadership forums, ensuring investment decisions are grounded in demonstrable business value. Business Applications & Solutions Own the regional Business Applications capability, ensuring applications enable efficient, scalable and reliable operations while supporting future growth. Establish and govern application development standards and solution architecture principles, approving technical direction within delegated authority. Drive continuous improvement, standardisation and lifecycle management across the portfolio to reduce technical debt and support long-term sustainability. Evaluate and recommend technology solutions, balancing business need, technical capability, commercial considerations and supportability. Software Development & Integration Build and lead a high-performing software development organisation capable of delivering secure, scalable and maintainable business solutions. Govern application integration across enterprise platforms, internally developed applications, customer systems and third-party technologies. Promote modern engineering practices that improve software quality, delivery capability and operational resilience. Retain sufficient technical credibility to constructively challenge architecture, design and delivery decisions made by the engineering team. Warehouse Management Systems & Logistics Solutions Provide strategic leadership for the Company's Warehouse Management System and logistics application capabilities, supporting their expansion across the region. Ensure WMS solutions evolve as an integrated part of the broader applications portfolio in support of operational excellence and regional growth. Balance customer-specific requirements against long-term product sustainability, standardisation and platform scalability. Leadership & Governance Develop organisational capability through effective organisation design, succession planning, coaching and leadership development. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement, encouraging adoption of emerging technologies where they deliver measurable business value. Ensure business applications comply with corporate governance, cybersecurity, regulatory and technology standards. Establish, negotiate and manage relationships with software vendors and implementation partners, exercising delegated authority within approved procurement and governance frameworks. QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Relevant professional certifications will be advantageous. Experience: Progressive experience with increasing leadership responsibility in enterprise applications, software development or technology solution delivery within medium to large organisations. Demonstrated experience leading regional or geographically distributed technology teams within a matrixed organisation. Proven track record delivering enterprise business applications and managing application portfolios and technology transformation initiatives. Experience with Warehouse Management Systems, logistics technology or supply chain solutions highly advantageous. Proven experience managing software vendors, implementation partners and outsourced service providers. Experience operating within multinational organisations and matrix reporting environments. Skills & Competencies: Strategic leadership with strong business and commercial acumen. Strong understanding of enterprise applications, software development and systems integration. Business partnership and stakeholder management across executive and country leadership levels. Financial management and budget accountability. Organisational leadership and people development. Technology governance and risk management. Vendor and commercial management. Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capability. Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organisational levels. Ability to translate business objectives into practical, scalable technology solutions.
